title: Specify the finite V3 genesis bootstrap and V4 autonomy handoff
goal: Produce an exact, testable and inactive proposal for the V4 development-base workflow and the finite transition from V3 genesis review to base-owned V4 governance.
acceptanceCriteria: The proposal identifies the already authorized local codex/v4-development-base branch and its recovery lineage.
The V3 bootstrap, dormant V4 base and V4 autonomy states have explicit entry evidence, allowed verdict authority and exit criteria.
The proposed V4-only workflow exposes v4-contract, v4-linux, v4-package and v4-required and obtains required verdicts from the previously trusted base.
Head candidate V4 code cannot judge its own change and missing base-owned governance fails closed.
Future active workflow and V3 trigger changes are named as separate authorization boundaries and are not applied by this checkpoint.
Current V3 validation remains green and no active workflow, ruleset or remote state changes.
